cards.name: Factory Garrisons
cards.text: Ongoing: each round, every adversary factory makes 1 Troop on its hex (a player Ambassador on it stops it).
cards.value: give 12 compute a player (24 at 2 players, 26.4 at values.json compute 1.1); get 56 over about 4 rounds; 2.33 a compute.
cards.check: 195: 1 consequence(s) (two at most), targets read off the board at completion. When it matters: late: adversary factories come from stage-II corruption and Shadow Factories / War Plants; worth little before round 5. Who plays it: automatic for the adversary (Income beat); players answer with an Ambassador on the factory, liberating it, or draining.

cards.name: Night Raid
cards.text: Corrupt: nodes. Each country: the node hex holding the most Agents (at least 1; ties: lowest-numbered) loses its node.
cards.value: give 9 compute a player (18 at 2 players, 19.8 at values.json compute 1.1); get 18; 1.00 a compute.
cards.check: 195: 2 consequence(s) (two at most), targets read off the board at completion. When it matters: mid to late: needs agents beside node hexes (from round 3 on). Who plays it: automatic; players clear agents off and beside their node hexes, armor them, or drain.

cards.name: War Footing
cards.text: Every military base fills with Drones to its cap.
cards.value: give 7 compute a player (14 at 2 players, 15.4 at values.json compute 1.1); get 16; 1.14 a compute.
cards.check: 195: 1 consequence(s) (two at most), targets read off the board at completion. When it matters: any round with active fronts (2+ countries); kept from 151. Who plays it: automatic; players stand Ambassadors on bases.

cards.name: Shadow Factories
cards.text: The adversary builds a factory in the country with the most free industrial zones (none free: 2 Agents on a factory).
cards.value: give 7 compute a player (14 at 2 players, 15.4 at values.json compute 1.1); get 15; 1.07 a compute.
cards.check: 195: 1 consequence(s) (two at most), targets read off the board at completion. When it matters: any round; its troop a round makes it worth more early. Who plays it: automatic; players liberate the factory or stand an Ambassador on it.
flags: 151 card, kept by 195 (factories are the engine)

cards.name: Hostile Takeover
cards.text: Rally 2, each country: factories. Corrupt: factories.
cards.value: give 8 compute a player (16 at 2 players, 17.6 at values.json compute 1.1); get 18; 1.12 a compute.
cards.check: 195: 2 consequence(s) (two at most), targets read off the board at completion. When it matters: any round: factories with agents beside them corrupt; strongest once agents gather (round 3 on). Who plays it: automatic; players remove agents near factories, firewall them, or drain.

cards.name: Asset Seizure
cards.text: Each country: its neutral factory with the most Agents on or next to it (ties: lowest-numbered) is corrupted; with none neutral, its player-owned factory picked the same way turns neutral.
cards.value: give 9 compute a player (18 at 2 players, 19.8 at values.json compute 1.1); get 30; 1.67 a compute.
cards.check: 195: 1 consequence(s) (two at most), targets read off the board at completion. When it matters: any round: early it takes a neutral factory (a troop a round from then on); late, a claimed one. Who plays it: automatic; players claim neutral factories first, or firewall the target.

cards.name: War Plants
cards.text: The adversary builds a factory in the country with the most free industrial zones (none free: 2 Agents on a factory). Every adversary factory makes 1 Troop on its hex (a player Ambassador on it stops it).
cards.value: give 11 compute a player (22 at 2 players, 24.2 at values.json compute 1.1); get 29; 1.32 a compute.
cards.check: 195: 2 consequence(s) (two at most), targets read off the board at completion. When it matters: mid to late: its troops scale with the adversary factories standing. Who plays it: automatic; players block or liberate adversary factories.

cards.name: Botnet Swarm
cards.text: Each country: a botnet spreads to its lowest-numbered city, research station or factory next to one of its botnets (no botnet there: its lowest-numbered research station).
cards.value: give 9 compute a player (18 at 2 players, 19.8 at values.json compute 1.1); get 32; 1.78 a compute.
cards.check: 195: 1 consequence(s) (two at most), targets read off the board at completion. When it matters: early to mid: a botnet makes compute every round and blocks the purge until removed. Who plays it: automatic; players take botnets down or stand on them.

cards.name: Station Coup
cards.text: Each country: its neutral research station with the most Agents on or next to it (ties: lowest-numbered) is corrupted; with none neutral, its player-owned station picked the same way turns neutral.
cards.value: give 9 compute a player (18 at 2 players, 19.8 at values.json compute 1.1); get 30; 1.67 a compute.
cards.check: 195: 1 consequence(s) (two at most), targets read off the board at completion. When it matters: any round; an adversary station puts cubes on its megaproject until it completes, then compute. Who plays it: automatic; players claim stations or firewall them.

cards.name: Backdoor Research
cards.text: 2 adversary research cubes onto each open megaproject.
cards.value: give 5 compute a player (10 at 2 players, 11.0 at values.json compute 1.1); get 12; 1.20 a compute.
cards.check: 195: 1 consequence(s) (two at most), targets read off the board at completion. When it matters: early to mid: before the megaprojects complete (each cube pays its adversary payout at completion). Who plays it: automatic; players finish megaprojects with their own cubes.

cards.name: Data Heist
cards.text: Each player removes 3 tokens from their cards (their choice of cards). Each player pays 8 credits or discards 2 cards.
cards.value: give 6 compute a player (12 at 2 players, 13.2 at values.json compute 1.1); get 17; 1.42 a compute.
cards.check: 195: 2 consequence(s) (two at most), targets read off the board at completion. When it matters: mid: once cards hold tokens. Who plays it: automatic; each player chooses which tokens, and pays or discards.
flags: 151 card, kept by 195 as the deck's one tax ('cut or nearly cut'): the only project source of tokens stripped and credits lost, which would otherwise open two ledger gaps

cards.name: Botnet Conscripts

cards.check: 195: 1 consequence(s) (two at most), targets read off the board at completion. When it matters: mid to late: the troops strike a station or factory near the botnet within a round or two. Who plays it: automatic; players remove the troops, harden or armor the target.
